# Rhinelander Auto Body

> Family-run collision repair and painting at 1909 White Plains Road in the Bronx, serving the Bronx, Lower Westchester and Manhattan since 1938.

The Restaino family started the business in 1938, and first cousins Pat and Ray Restaino incorporated Rhinelander Auto Body in 1982. Pat still works from the same shop.

Services: collision repair, expert paint matching in a high-tech spray booth, welding, simonizing, detailing and glass, computerized insurance estimates, 24-hour towing, a 24-hour answering service and rental cars while yours is in the shop. Estimates are free.

Hours are 8AM to 5:30PM, Monday through Friday. Call the shop at 718.822.8905 (fax 718.822.7844), or call 718.823.1313 for 24-hour towing, day or night. The shop is on the right side of White Plains Road at Rhinelander Avenue, near the Bronx Zoo exit of the Bronx River Parkway.
